_comment: REG-323 T4.5 / T4.5b / plan D-9. A browser AI never sends config.json (the ingest policy denies it); it may PROPOSE property changes in npdev-config-proposal.json, and npdev_relay_config.py sorts each one. A knob gets an entry only if it lives OUTSIDE model.json (the AI already changes model.json) AND an existing CLI writer sets it (`writer`, registered in npdev_relay_config.WRITERS): no writer, no knob. Language, date format, currency, page size and time zone live in model.json and have no entry (see `located`); the app's theme (ui.theme.name, ui.theme.choices) is config.json defaults, written by `npdev config set-default`, so it has two. An applicable item is applied ONLY when the owner confirms its `confirmCode` (config:<property>), inside the same all-or-nothing write as the model, and undo restores the old config.json. Every other proposal is shown as 'you can do that in Settings' and never applied.

entries.preview: The AI asked to use the theme {value} for the whole app. This changes config.json when you apply the answer, and you can undo it.
The AI asked to offer these themes for people to choose from: {value}. This changes config.json when you apply the answer, and you can undo it.

entryShape.property: dotted path in config.json, e.g. console.mode
entryShape.type: string | enum | boolean | integer | themeId (one theme that exists or arrives with the answer) | themeIds ("*" or a comma list of them)
entryShape.values: for enum: the allowed values; for integer: {"min": n, "max": n}
entryShape.writer: the name of a function registered in npdev_relay_config.WRITERS: the CLI's own pure writer (`npdev config set-default`, npdev_config_defaults.set_default_text), whose output the apply step puts on disk inside its all-or-nothing transaction -- never a raw file write

located.how: settings.locale (informational tag) and settings.strings (the text that is actually overridden)
presentationMetadata.currency on the field or concept that shows money

the app's theme is config.json defaults["ui.theme.name"] (a built-in id or a themes/<id>.json beside model.json) and defaults["ui.theme.choices"] the ones an end user may pick (flat keys; model.schema.json's settings.ui takes only pageRows and dateFormat); guidePage.theme in model.json sets one guide page's own look. Since T4.5b `npdev config set-default` writes `defaults`, and both settings have an entry: the theme FILE arrives as themes/*.json (T4.3a), the selection as a config proposal the owner ticks
no built-in setting: declare a properties[] entry so the scoped-property cascade carries it
scenario.name is the app's IDENTITY (it names the output folder), so it is never changed from a chat
